changelog:
A small release, mostly about what happens when something goes wrong.

**Catch-up**
- Watching a programme from the beginning now plays to its end. The player was
  treating an archived programme as live, so reaching the end of one looked like
  the provider dropping the stream and it reconnected you to the start.
- Pausing an archived programme and resuming now continues where you were,
  instead of jumping to what is on air.

**Titles**
- Films whose provider supplies a TMDB id now show a synopsis, year, runtime and
  rating. Series have had this without an account since v0.2.0; the film side
  needed a key, and this is the first build carrying one. A film your provider
  gives no id for still shows only what the provider sent — titles are never
  guessed by name, because a confident match on the wrong film is worse than
  none.
- Nothing is requested until you open a title, and answers are cached.

**Under the hood**
- Nothing about your sources, favourites or history changes, and no refresh is
  needed after upgrading.

Known limits: multi-view, picture-in-picture, DVR and recording are not in this
build. Catch-up has not been tested against a real provider archive.
